name: Clinical French NER Benchmark
description: A benchmark evaluating clinical named entity recognition systems on French clinical text to compare model performance on clinical NER tasks.
evaluation_method: F1 (entity-level precision/recall/F1, exact entity span and label match)
reputation: A niche, domain-specific benchmark used primarily in Francophone clinical NLP research with limited adoption outside clinical NLP specialists.
notes: Sensitive clinical text (privacy/de-identification concerns); relatively small and domain-specific dataset; annotation variability across clinical notes; not an LLM-specific benchmark and risk of training/test contamination if models were trained on similar clinical corpora.
